author: 1KillerChris
body: Hello there! My Minecraft account name is 1KillerChris I have been playing on this server since WallsMC. This server has grown so much over the past years. This server's Nebula is my favorite PvP mini-game. The only thing is I have been sadly banned.  Please do not hate me for making this as a ban appeal which I am in fact, but I was recently banned for Ban Evasion. The thing is I was at my cousin's house with my good friend Kenfoo. Kenfoo was hacking and had gotten banned the day before and when nether_worldfire (my cousin) had gone on to play Nebula this day we got banned for Ban Evasion something me and my cousin weren't doing.

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Hay 1KillerChris,

I was the moderator that banned you and your cousin for ban evasion.
After checking the ips again, we found out that he was in fact your cousin.
I've requested that the ban will be removed.

Have a good day!
Regards Flo/resepignev

Edit: Both bans have been removed!
